page.notes: Blue pen marks and underlining in the margins and over some page numbers are handwriting, not transcribed. Page-number entries are reproduced as printed, some with handwritten corrections on the scan. Some page numbers at "277. 278" and "302" were partly overwritten and may be misread. The running head line begins with a large decorative initial Z, read as Z. The imprint "Typis Christiani Goezi" is set in small capitals; the final letter of Goezi is printed as in the scan. The handwritten number "VA 1 152736" at the foot is a shelf mark and is left out.
